claims: The Artemis 2 mission is planned as a 10-day flight.
The Artemis 2 mission is designed to send four astronauts around the Moon and back to Earth.
The Artemis 2 crew will spend several days in high Earth orbit testing systems.
The Artemis 2 mission includes a roughly four-day journey to the Moon.
The Artemis 2 mission includes a trip around the far side of the Moon.
The Artemis 2 mission return is a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
Artemis 2 mission total duration is approximately 10 days.
Artemis 2 is the first crewed flight to test the Orion spacecraft systems in deep space.
Artemis 2 crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis 2 trajectory is a "free-return" loop around the Moon.
Artemis 2 is launched on April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center.
Artemis 2 will not land on the Moon.
Artemis 2 serves as the precursor to the Artemis 3 mission.
The Artemis 3 mission plans to land humans on the lunar surface.
